purpose: Commissioned native integration and proof obligations within the existing #65 UX spine; no new story IDs, runtime, storage or evidence system. The 2026-09-16 Workcell-root NOW clarification is carried through these same obligations rather than a second test registry.
standing: agent-inference; source-grounded implementation/testing map commissioned 2026-09-14 and temporally clarified 2026-09-16

grounding220.policy: Read full source, docs/experience/WORKCELL-NOW-TEMPORAL-FIELD.md, current owner tickets and exact source cut. These joins preserve accepted Factory design and earlier stories/obligations; declaration is not runtime or human evidence.

obligations.requirement: Choose or continue legitimate existing/new work with real source, Workcell-root NOW, bounded child working destination and required/preferred environment; preserve thin/external sessions and the explicit rich Herdr reference.
required_branches: Each participating Workcell has one stable root NOW for the World; actual root/Project/task work resolves to a bounded child NOW beneath the selected Workcell horizon.
Root versus Project concern follows the actual subject; root NOW, child NOW, material cwd and source ownership remain distinct.
Parallel tasks receive distinct child NOW writable material; same-task retry/reconnect reuses the intended child relation.
No forced source migration or adoption of a guessed Guardian/default Workcell relation.
A required host/environment cannot silently fall back; a preference can resolve only with a disclosed supported alternative.

obligations.requirement: Maintain exact Workcell/root-NOW/child-NOW/AgentSession/SessionSpace/provider/material relations across view movement, re-observation, explicit recreation and concurrent sessions.
required_branches: WorkcellRef, root NowRef, child NowRef, SessionSpaceRef, AgentSessionRef, provider workspace and process identity remain separate.

Two sessions may share Project, Workcell, provider server, executable and labels while retaining distinct child NOW/context/writable scope; host/start marker/provider generation distinguishes material.
Stale binding or reused pane/session name must not redirect input, interrupt, close or inherit another child NOW.
View continuity, native resume, context rehydration and successor session retain distinct evidence while the established temporal relation is preserved or explicitly succeeded.
Creation interrupted before binding persistence reconciles material before another task starts.

obligations.requirement: Extend actual Workcell observations to provider places and each live process, preserving executable-based inventory aggregation, root/child NOW correlations supplied by owners, and external unattributed work.
required_branches: Reuse resource_usage process-start/executable evidence; a PID, pane or provider workspace is not Workcell/root NOW/child NOW identity.
Unknown/failed/stale reads remain unknown, never empty healthy state or invented Agent/Factory/NOW ancestry.
Local and selected remote observations retain source, freshness, lifetime and authority; no new Central-like meta register.
Where semantic correlations are supplied, retain exact Workcell/root NOW/child NOW and provider-generation provenance without inspecting private payloads.
Foreign processes and resident services survive bounded observation and cleanup.

obligations.requirement: Make the existing Herdr adapter reachable through AIKit public environment operations and retained working-Surface bindings; prove actual open/attach/focus/close/recovery as Surfaces within the established Workcell root/child NOW relation.
required_branches: Herdr reference, tmux portability and optional cmux each require their own real evidence beneath the same provider-neutral temporal/session relation.
Root NOW survives ordinary Surface/provider churn; finishing or releasing one child need not end the resident Workcell horizon.
Keep #311 unpublished work and ReobservedUnproven/ReboundByExplicitOpen semantics; don't reconstruct another session to claim resume.
Isolate tmux clients when their target dies; no switch/input leakage to a resident job and no global config rewrite.
Separate Herdr valid-PTY missing-target behaviour from no-TTY preflight; use actual installed command syntax.
Closing a view, interrupting a turn, closing a pane, quiescing a child NOW and destroying material have different effects.

obligations.requirement: Resolve source/identity/praxis/context/model/harness/environment/authority through the existing native composition, bind it to the selected Workcell root/child NOW, and expose confirmed target-effective behaviour.
required_branches: Scope-neutral composition includes Herdr, graphical and client/UI contributions; do not make all composition harness-shaped or NOW-shaped.
Distinguish resolution scope, activation scope, temporal address and lifetime, plus selected/projected/loaded/action-usable/enforced states.
Two sessions/child NOWs in one Project with different context/skills remain isolated when one changes.
Native model policy/routes, required tools, harness faculties and material placement re-resolve together; no private desktop roster.
Opening/focusing another Surface preserves the existing child NOW; deliberate move/re-placement establishes the target Workcell/root NOW relation explicitly.
Useful permitted source-dependent task proves loading; generated file alone is insufficient and unsupported readback remains explicit.

obligations.requirement: Join actual governing authority to a bounded grant and admitted Agency, allocate/bind the correct child NOW, then exact prepared body, real dispatch/result and attributable Activity; correlate Factory only when commissioned.
required_branches: Actuation #84 continues accepted Rust #58; do not rebuild the gate or let Factory/React fabricate grants.
Wrong holder, World, operation, bounds, revoked/expired or unknown authority refuses before effects.
Addressing, session contribution, delegation and independent cooperation retain their native differences.
Bounded delegation allocates a child NOW before child material/session launch; children have bounded effects/lifetime/budget/return and independent verification.
Pi and harness-native delegation map to the same Agency→child NOW→session/material→Return contract; provider team/subagent IDs stay provenance.
A gateway append, transport ack, terminal creation or human unsent draft does not stand in for actual Agent action.

obligations.requirement: Prove permitted work and return routes through detached UI, connection loss and selected service/provider restart while retaining the correct root/child NOW continuity or explicit successor/recovery.
required_branches: Provider server, Workcell service, Gateway, root NOW, child NOW and UI have separate lifetimes and tested failure boundaries.
Account for pending tool/permission, uncertain external effect, late response and replay before consequential retry.
Context/history restoration is not native session resume; re-created process is not the old material, while a stable root/child semantic continuation remains explicit where valid.
Primary workstation can be offline while Omarchy continues attributable child work; later receipt retains original occurrence/Workcell/NOW provenance.
Failure of one selected provider/connection leaves unrelated sessions and sibling child NOWs usable.
No unsupported exactly-once guarantee or hidden duplicated turn on restart.

obligations.requirement: Prove remote access to the same living Workcell/root/child NOW separately from deliberate execution re-placement onto a real second material host/root NOW.
required_branches: Multi-host view leaves processes and root NOWs on their owning hosts; source sync, access and execution movement stay separate.
Remote attach/open reaches the existing Workcell/root/child NOW; it does not allocate a new target horizon.
Resolve target offers/source/storage/credentials/authority with no silent required-target fallback.
Deliberate movement resolves the target Workcell root NOW, establishes explicit child continuation/successor provenance, accounts for in-flight effects and revalidates target loading/authority.
Resume only where native support proves it; otherwise identify rehydration/successor and old/new attempt/material relation.
Prove target operation before release; prevent competing consequential execution and reconcile late old-host output.
Two directories and sampled differing IDs do not prove second-host recovery or permanent identifier uniqueness.

obligations.requirement: Recover existing Field Guardian/product Agent expressions, formation/default/skill provenance, resolve supported selections and prove actual ordinary harness activation.
required_branches: Central world default_agent_set_ref and orchestrator_agent_ref already exist; repair consumers and source gaps rather than recreate fields.
Generic support, declared source, local adoption, effective selection and target loading are separate.
Private source/default adoption remains the owner's actual scoped choice; explicit and profile-less legitimate work remains usable.
Purpose/Focus/Knowledge/praxis differentiates Guardians; no privileged meta-profile class or authority from being a Guardian.
Guardian/default placement may select an eligible Workcell/root NOW but does not grant authority or collapse the Agent into that material horizon.
Central source operations stay in C; AIKit readers/projection/loading stay in A.

obligations.requirement: Carry real commissioned work through exact admitted execution, independent work/verification, native Git, durable structured outputs/handoff and Central temporal continuation across Workcell root/child NOWs and Routine occurrences.
required_branches: Trace Run/attempt, Agency/session, Workcell/root NOW/child NOW, working Surface, material observation, Activity and exact tested Git basis.
Queued Run plus unrelated terminal never counts as Factory execution; native direct/external work stays valid.
One Journey/Run may span both primary and Omarchy NOW horizons and cross a personal Day boundary without semantic identity drift.
Routine trigger origin and execution destination temporal addresses remain distinct; Day rollover schedules nothing.
Actual result bodies remain reachable after terminal/view closure and feed the adopted shared HTML template family and exact continuing child work.
New revision exposes stale evidence; completion, Recognition and Git integration stay distinct.
Factory telemetry/readback preserves owner-native temporal/material provenance rather than creating a second NOW/DAY/event store.

obligations.requirement: Connect native desktop/TUI/Gateway/Omarchy entry and attention to the exact current work through one frameable NOW grammar, preserving accepted Factory and ordinary arrangements.
required_branches: One canonical conversation/session Surface; movement preserves draft/focus and does not clone or redirect work.
My Now aggregates eligible personal Workcell root NOWs; Workcell Now, Project Now, Journey Now and Agent Now are frames over the same native refs.
Footer → Observatory → Herdr/tmux/desktop opens the exact current child/session; open/focus differs visibly from move/re-place.
Factory centre work/right artifacts/footer attention remains the accepted design and exposes temporal/material depth without becoming a scheduler dashboard.
Personal Today remains the human Day while Omarchy can continue independently and late Returns preserve original occurrence address.
Provider-bound focus and alternate Surface open exact permitted subject; denied compositor action gets supported recovery.
Closing desktop leaves supported work alive; one unavailable service does not obscure unrelated usable work.
Record narrow/medium/wide and keyboard/pointer behaviour in actual installed host; human visual acceptance remains separate.

obligations.requirement: Execute the complete connected source→two Workcell root NOWs→operative Agent→Herdr Factory work alongside Direct tmux/external harness→bounded delegation→independent verification→output→recovery→Routine→real remote access/re-placement→personal Day→SharedField projection walk.
required_branches: Primary workstation and Omarchy each retain one stable root NOW with multiple bounded children under one personal Day.
Exercise every available admitted harness against actual faculties with economical eligible models; label unavailable/unsupported/failed branches.
A Pi/other parent delegation allocates a child NOW before child launch and returns attributable evidence; include Pi→Pi and Pi→different-harness where available.
A Routine trigger on one Workcell can execute on the other with origin/destination temporal address, authority/proof revalidation and duplicate/restart protection.
Primary-offline/Omarchy-live case reconciles later without rewriting occurrence or root/child NOW provenance.
Remote access to living Omarchy work remains distinct from deliberate second placement onto the primary Workcell/root NOW.
One Factory Journey/Run spans both Workcell horizons and a Day boundary; exact child Activity/Return appears consistently in Project/Journey/Observatory/My-Now frames.

Explicit audience-scoped SpaceTimeDB FieldNow/FieldDay projection updates live, reconciles after service loss and excludes private/unprojected NOW/source/log material from hosted/search/Encounter surfaces.
Preserve original TM02 failed certification and bounded successes; repair invalid syntax/count/PTY/PID assertions without rewriting evidence.
Keep actual source/build/install/running/provider versions, production checks and real material receipts; fixtures establish only their own boundary.
Independent verifier tests the same changed cut; required H comes from the human.
Existing CAW/QL/installation and Factory obligations remain; no provider smoke or map compilation closes the whole.

Workcell-root NOW, child allocation, cross-Workcell Routine/delegation, personal-Day reconciliation and FieldNow/FieldDay are part of those same obligations.
